question: Simplify : 81 × 81 + 68 × 68 - 2 × 81 × 68
solution:
**Formula used:**

(a - b)² = a² + b² - 2ab 

**Calculation:**

81 × 81 + 68 × 68 - 2 × 81 × 68 

This can be written as

81² + 68² - 2 × 81 × 68 

By using the above identity

(81 - 68)² = 13² = 169

**∴ 81 × 81 + 68 × 68 - 2 × 81 × 68 = 169.**
